deterministic_data.verification: PostgreSQL v3 is closed for 25 tables and the deterministic PostgresCabinetUnitOfWork surface; the operation-scoped UoW factory, protected filesystem byte store, deterministic timezone-aware UTC system clock, recoverable source-publication journal, transfer/Registry/recovery evidence, and sole bootstrap composition root are all assembled. Final Workbench assembly is 9/9 ready with zero errors.
